item.title: AWS Introduces Preview of Well-Architected Agent
item.description: AWS recently announced the preview of the Well-Architected Agent, a service that analyzes environments against Well-Architected best practices and provides prioritized recommendations across cost, security, performance, and reliability. (1 source: infoq)
